title: Small Seeds Wake Up
paras: Omar has a small seed shop. He has a short grey [[beard|beard]] and likes talking about plants. People come here to do their spring [[shopping|shopping]]. He puts the seed bags in order by name, from A to Z, following the [[alphabet|alphabet]]. He uses a [[computer|computer]] to make labels. Each label has the shop's [[address|address]], so people can find him again.

On his table is a clear [[box|box]] with bean seeds inside. The seeds sit on [[wet|wet]] paper. This shows people how plants start to [[grow|grow]]. First, a seed takes in water and gets bigger. Its skin opens. A little root comes out and goes down. Next, a green shoot goes up. The seed has food inside to help it start.

Omar keeps the seeds warm, but he does not cover them with water. They need air too. After a few days, he puts the little plants in soil near the window. Their leaves use light to make food. Watching them is [[fun|fun]] for his visitors. Some hope to [[win|win]] a prize for the tallest bean plant at the summer fair. It all starts with one small seed.
zh: 奥马尔有一家小种子店。他留着短短的灰胡子，喜欢聊植物。人们来这里购买春天要用的东西。他按名称将种子袋依照字母表顺序从A到Z排列。他用电脑制作标签。每张标签上都有店铺的地址，方便人们再次找到他。
他的桌上有一个透明盒子，里面放着菜豆种子。种子放在湿纸上，让人们看到植物是怎样开始生长的。首先，种子吸收水分，变得更大。种皮裂开，一条小根钻出来，向下生长。接着，一根绿色的嫩芽向上生长。种子内部储存的养分帮助它开始生长。
奥马尔让种子保持温暖，但不会让水淹没它们。它们也需要空气。几天后，他把这些小苗种进窗边的土里。叶子利用光制造养分。看着它们生长，来店里的人都觉得很有趣。有些人希望在夏季集市上凭最高的菜豆植株赢得奖项。而这一切，都从一颗小小的种子开始。

q.s: The labels tell buyers where Omar's shop is.
q.why: 标签上有店铺地址，方便人们再来。

q.s: The green shoot appears before the root.
q.why: 文中先长出小根，接着才长出绿芽。

q.s: The summer fair gives money to the winner.
q.why: 文中提到奖项，但没有说明奖品是什么。
